svg.title: cwtrain hot-load flow, Axolotl SFT recipe
svg.desc: The trainer Job runs axolotl train, and axolotl merge-lora after a LoRA run. Then launch.py checks the result against the base model and writes one full snapshot. cwtrain uploads it to AI Object Storage, creates a hot-load and polls until every replica is READY: the deployment's replicas load the snapshot and its OpenAI-compatible endpoint serves the fine-tuned weights. This happens once per run, after training.
svg.text: checks the result; one FULL snapshot
